newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart confident of better sales, earnings.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart confident of better sales, earnings.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc, reporting higher results for the fourth quarter ended January 31, said Tuesday it is confident its current fiscal year will produce record sales and earnings and significant improvement in shareholder value.
David Glass, president and chief executive officer, made the comment as the retailer reported record sales of $104.9 billion for the year ended January 31.
It was the 26th consecutive year of record sales and earnings for Wal-Mart, Glass said.
All operating divisions reported an increase in the comparable-store sales growth and improved profits over the prior year, he said.

Wal-Mart's strong earnings performance and improved asset management resulted in free cash flow of over $3 billion, resulting from an aggressive capital expenditure program, and an increase in return on assets, he said.
For the fourth quarter, the company's Wal-Mart division, including Supercenters, had an operating profit of $1.888 billion, up from $1.651 billion a year earlier.
Fiscal year operating profit for the division was $5.548 billion, a rise of 11 percent over the $5.020 billion reported last year.

Its Sam's division recorded operating profit for the quarter of $274 million, compared to $231 million for the same prior year quarter. Sam's operating profit for year was $864 million, an increase of 8.0 percent over the $800 million reported in the prior fiscal year.
The company's international divisioon recorded an operating profit of $65 million for the most recent quarter, compared with a loss of $13 million a year earlier.
For the year, the division recorded an operating profit of $24 million, compared with a year-earlier loss of $16 million.
